integrity: The result derives exact formulas from an established bipartite k-matching halfspace representation. No independent audit or certification has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Connected simple biregular bipartite support, left vertex class smaller than the right vertex class, standard intrinsic Euclidean metric; irregular/equal-part graph cases and general edge weights are not classified. This is an analytical proof accompanied by finite numerical cross-checks, not independent validation.
title: Cycle-space incenter loci and sharp radius phases of biregular bipartite matching polytopes
